principles.q: When a page gets busy it stops being a symphony and becomes noise. One frame, given space, beats six crowded together.
Every image and film must show our real frames, true to shape and colourway. Off-brand or inaccurate imagery is the single biggest risk to the business.
No purely AI presentation. Human models, real faces on About, real packaging, real craft.

call_quotes: I wasn't expecting to be satisfied today.
